verdict.rationale: Trivy documents a dedicated license scanner that scans container images/filesystem for license files and gives an opinionated risk view (trivy-docs-5), which covers license detection. However, the evidence pack shows no explicit documentation of policy enforcement mechanisms (e.g., failing builds on disallowed licenses via --exit-code/--severity gating specific to license scanning) beyond the general vulnerability exit-code gating shown in probes. Missing for 10: explicit license-policy configuration/allowlist-denylist docs, CI examples of failing a build on license violations, and independent confirmation of enforcement working in practice.
